'''Araz Aliyev''' is an Azerbaijani public official and economic policy expert who worked at the [[State Agency for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control|State Service for Antimonopoly Policy and Consumer Market Control]] from 1993 till 2021.<ref name=":5">{{Cite web |title=Antiinhisar Siyasəti və İstehlakçıların Hüquqlarının Müdafiəsi Dövlət Xidməti |url=http://consumer.gov.az/az/article/400 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200516063909/http://consumer.gov.az/az/article/400 |archive-date=2020-05-16 |access-date=2026-06-18 |website=consumer.gov.az |language=az-az}}</ref> During his time working there he helped to establish consumer rights protection,<ref>{{Cite news |date=8 November 2012 |title=İl ərzində 80 tona yaxın yararsız ərzaq malları satışdan çıxarılb |trans-title=Nearly 80 tons of food products were withdrawn from sale during this year. |url=https://525.az/news/2525-il-erzinde-80-tona-yaxin-yararsiz-erzaq-mallari-satisdan-cixarilb |url-status=live hüquqları ilə bağlı geniş maarifləndirmə tədbirləri görülür |trans-title=Extensive awareness-raising measures are being taken regarding antimonopoly policy and consumer rights. |url=https://azertag.az/xeber/antiinhisar_siyaseti_ve_istehlakchi_huquqlari_ile_bagli_genis_maariflendirme_tedbirleri_gorulur-1026331 |url-status= |work=[[Azerbaijan State News Agency]] |language=az |agency=[[Azerbaijan State News Agency]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=30 September 2015 |title=İstehlakçıların maarifləndirilməsi tədbirləri davam etdirilir |trans-title=Consumer awareness activities Aliyev's work has been associated with the institutionalization of Azerbaijan's antimonopoly and consumer market supervision frameworks and is now one of the central regulatory aspects of the [[State Agency for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control]] under the [[President of Azerbaijan|President of the Republic of Azerbaijan]]. State Service for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control lately was reorganized<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 August 2024 |title=Antiinhisar və istehlak bazarına nəzarət sahələrində idarəetmənin təkmilləşdirilməsi ilə bağlı əlavə tədbirlər haqqında Azərbaycan Respublikası Prezidentinin Fərmanı |trans-title=Decree of the President of the Republic of Azerbaijan on Additional Measures to Improve Governance in the Fields of Antimonopoly Regulation and Consumer Market Supervision. |url=https://president.az/az/articles/view/66745 |url-status=live |website=president.az |language=az |publication-date=27 August 2024}}</ref> into the [[State Agency for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control]] under the [[President of Azerbaijan|President of the Republic of Azerbaijan]] and has been transformed directly to be  responsible for preventing unfair competition, regulating monopolistic practices and promoting consumer market standards in line with national economic reforms till this day.

== Early life and career ==

=== Education ===
Araz Anvar oghlu Aliyev was born in 1956 in the village of Kasaman, Goycha District. He studied until the eighth grade in Kasaman and later completed his education at Narimanli Village High School. Later he was admitted to [[Azerbaijan State University of Economics|Azerbaijani National Economy Institute (Azerbaijan State University of Economics)]]. During his studies due to his outstanding performance and grades, he was selected by the university and the Ministry of Higher Education to be transferred directly to [[Moscow State University]] to continue his education there. He graduated from the [[Moscow State University]] named after [[Mikhail Lomonosov|M. V. Lomonosov]] in 1979 and completed his postgraduate studies at the same university in 1983 as a Political Economist.<ref name=":5" />

=== Career ===
Between 1984 and 1993, Aliyev worked at the [[Azerbaijan State Agricultural University|Azerbaijan Agricultural Institute (Azerbaijan State Agricultural University)]] named after [[Samad aga Agamalioglu|S. Agamalioghlu]], where he served as a lecturer and senior lecturer. From 1993 to 2001, he held various positions within the [[State Agency for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control|State Committee for Antimonopoly Policy and Entrepreneurship Assistance]] of the Republic of Azerbaijan, including as chief specialist and department head.<ref name=":5" />

From 2001 to 2007, he worked in the [[State Agency for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control|Antimonopoly Policy Department]] of the [[Ministry of Economy (Azerbaijan)|Ministry of Economic Development of Azerbaijan]], serving as sector head and department chief. Between 2007 and 2010, he served as Deputy Head of the State Antimonopoly Service under the Ministry of Economic Development.<ref name=":5" />

Since January 25, 2010, Aliyev has worked at the State Service for Antimonopoly Policy and Protection of Consumer Rights under the Ministry of Economic Development. From 2014 onward, he continued serving as Deputy Head of the [[State Agency for Antimonopoly and Consumer Market Control|State Service for Antimonopoly Policy and Protection of Consumer Rights]] under the [[Ministry of Economy (Azerbaijan)|Ministry of Economy of the Republic of Azerbaijan]].<ref name=":5" />
